entries.name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
entries.summary: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.

entries.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
entries.summary: The product constructs all or part of an SQL command using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify the intended SQL command when it is sent to a downstream component.

entries.name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
entries.summary: The web application does not, or cannot, sufficiently verify whether a request was intentionally provided by the user who sent the request, which could have originated from an unauthorized actor.

entries.name: Missing Authorization
entries.summary: The product does not perform an authorization check when an actor attempts to access a resource or perform an action.

entries.name: Out-of-bounds Write
entries.summary: The product writes data past the end, or before the beginning, of the intended buffer.

entries.name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
entries.summary: The product uses external input to construct a pathname that is intended to identify a file or directory that is located underneath a restricted parent directory, but the product does not properly neutralize special elements within the pathname that can cause the pathname to reso

entries.name: Use After Free
entries.summary: The product reuses or references memory after it has been freed.

entries.name: Out-of-bounds Read
entries.summary: The product reads data past the end, or before the beginning, of the intended buffer.

entries.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
entries.summary: The product constructs all or part of an OS command using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify the intended OS command when it is sent to a downstream component.

entries.name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
entries.summary: The product constructs all or part of a code segment using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify the syntax or behavior of the intended code segment.

entries.name: Buffer Copy without Checking Size of Input ('Classic Buffer Overflow')
entries.summary: The product copies an input buffer to an output buffer without verifying that the size of the input buffer is less than the size of the output buffer.

entries.name: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
entries.summary: The product allows the upload or transfer of dangerous file types that are automatically processed within its environment.

entries.name: NULL Pointer Dereference
entries.summary: The product dereferences a pointer that it expects to be valid but is NULL.

entries.name: Stack-based Buffer Overflow
entries.summary: A stack-based buffer overflow condition is a condition where the buffer being overwritten is allocated on the stack (i.e., is a local variable or, rarely, a parameter to a function).

entries.name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
entries.summary: The product deserializes untrusted data without sufficiently ensuring that the resulting data will be valid.

entries.name: Heap-based Buffer Overflow
entries.summary: A heap overflow condition is a buffer overflow, where the buffer that can be overwritten is allocated in the heap portion of memory, generally meaning that the buffer was allocated using a routine such as malloc().

entries.name: Incorrect Authorization
entries.summary: The product performs an authorization check when an actor attempts to access a resource or perform an action, but it does not correctly perform the check.

entries.name: Improper Input Validation
entries.summary: The product receives input or data, but it does not validate or incorrectly validates that the input has the properties that are required to process the data safely and correctly.

entries.name: Improper Access Control
entries.summary: The product does not restrict or incorrectly restricts access to a resource from an unauthorized actor.

entries.name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
entries.summary: The product exposes sensitive information to an actor that is not explicitly authorized to have access to that information.

entries.name: Missing Authentication for Critical Function
entries.summary: The product does not perform any authentication for functionality that requires a provable user identity or consumes a significant amount of resources.

entries.name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
entries.summary: The web server receives a URL or similar request from an upstream component and retrieves the contents of this URL, but it does not sufficiently ensure that the request is being sent to the expected destination.

entries.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')
entries.summary: The product constructs all or part of a command using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify the intended command when it is sent to a downstream component.

entries.name: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key
entries.summary: The system's authorization functionality does not prevent one user from gaining access to another user's data or record by modifying the key value identifying the data.

entries.name: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling
entries.summary: The product allocates a reusable resource or group of resources on behalf of an actor without imposing any intended restrictions on the size or number of resources that can be allocated.
